reason: I already learn from free YouTube and TikTok clips, and tom yum, pad see ew and massaman are all on there in Thai for nothing. I might download it to poke at the free green curry, but in a normal week I just follow a clip, and I don't pay for recipes.
objection: Why pay 99 baht for an elephant telling me steps when I can watch a real person cook it free and see how the pan should look? And my condo kitchen is one pan and a rice cooker, so cooking three dishes on Sunday for the whole week won't fit in my tiny fridge anyway.
would_change_my_mind: If I actually cooked the free green curry and it came out clearly better than my YouTube attempts, I would pay the 99 for the pack.
